aggregator.explanation: Lesson 1 is the clear overall winner by weighted dimension votes. Four high-confidence agents favored Lesson 1: interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and concept accuracy, with especially strong confidence around 0.95–0.99. These dimensions indicate that Lesson 1 has a verifiable interactive checkpoint, clear narration, aligned timed cues, and correct explanation of the knapsack DP recurrence and solution. Lesson 2 won visual accuracy and polish, including a cleaner and more consistently legible visual presentation, but those two wins are outweighed by the absence of available transcript, timing, interaction specs, or script evidence in several core pedagogical dimensions. Lesson 1 has notable visual and polish flaws, but its instructional substance and implementation are much better established.
